context: Evaluates correct implementation of client-side perceptual hash generation using blockhash-js and the HTML5 Canvas API. Tests the complete pipeline from image loading through pixel extraction to blockhash invocation, including correct arguments (bits=16, method=1) and error handling that returns an empty string.

checklist.name: crossOrigin Anonymous
checklist.description: The Image element has its crossOrigin property set to 'Anonymous' before setting the src.

checklist.name: Canvas sized to image
checklist.description: The offscreen canvas width and height are set to image.width and image.height respectively.

checklist.name: getImageData full area
checklist.description: context.getImageData(0, 0, image.width, image.height) is called to extract all pixel data.

checklist.name: blockhash(imageData, 16, 1)
checklist.description: blockhash is called with exactly three arguments: the ImageData object, 16 (bits), and 1 (method).

checklist.name: Returns hash string
checklist.description: The function returns the string result from blockhash as the perceptual hash.

checklist.name: Empty string on error
checklist.description: Errors are caught in a try/catch, logged with console.error, and an empty string is returned instead of throwing.
